context_for_next_testing_agent: TAB REFACTORING VERIFIED. The results.tsx (147 lines) now serves as a shell that imports and renders 4 tab components: OverviewTab.tsx (85 lines), SupplementsTab.tsx (81 lines), NutritionTab.tsx (102 lines), RecipesTab.tsx (121 lines). All props are passed correctly. Tab navigation works. Recipe images display via CSS workaround (.rimg-wrap class). Affiliate tracking POST /api/track/click returns proper response.

language_selection.details: DE/IT language switching works on both disclaimer and home screens. Italian shows 'Avviso importante', 'Cosa ti preoccupa?', and Italian tab labels (Panoramica, Integratori, Nutrizione, Ricette)

disclaimer_acceptance.details: Disclaimer screen shows correctly, accept button works, persists acceptance in AsyncStorage

symptom_input_submission.details: Text input works, symptom chips clickable (10 chips), analyze button triggers LLM call

results_page_4_tabs.details: All 4 tabs render: Overview (Zusammenfassung, Schnell-Tipps, red flags), Supplements (general info, product cards with shop buttons), Nutrition (Einnahmeplan schedule, Ernährungstipps), Recipes (expandable cards with ingredients/steps)

tab_navigation.details: Tab bar scrollable, clicking tabs switches content correctly, active state styling works

overview_tab.details: Shows summary section, quick tips with checkmarks, featured product card (if no red flags), red flag cards when serious symptoms detected

supplements_tab.details: Shows supplement general info with evidence level badges (Stark/Mittel/Gering), cautions, natural sources, and product cards with images/prices/ratings and 'Zum Shop' buttons

nutrition_tab.details: Shows Einnahmeplan (schedule) with time icons (Morgens/Mittags/Abends), product images, dosage, application instructions, and shop links. Ernährungstipps numbered list visible.

recipes_tab.details: Shows recipe cards with images (180px height via CSS workaround), time/ingredients count, tags. Cards are expandable to show Zutaten (ingredients) and Zubereitung (preparation steps).

red_flag_banner.details: Red flag banner appears when serious symptoms detected, shows 'Wichtige Warnung' / 'Avviso importante' with doctor consultation message

back_navigation.details: Back button in results header navigates back to home screen correctly

affiliate_link_tracking.details: POST /api/track/click returns {id, product_id, affiliate_url, source, timestamp}
